name: organic-hub-to-amazon-2026-09
activation_note: PREPARED ONLY. Two separate switches: `active` turns the report on, and a record in `publications` (url + observed_at + evidence) is what starts the measurement window. A scheduled task, a written RSS file or a prepared post is never a publication.
kill_switch: set active=false (or delete this file) — organic_experiment_report.py then reports inactive and reads nothing

books_excluded_after_qa.senior-smartphone-french: top earner but the listing promises interior images and the EPUB has none (catalogue_quality 2026-09-12). Sending traffic to an unmet promise risks returns and reviews, and the fix would need a republish, which is frozen. Zero sales is not claimed for it — it is the top earner; the exclusion is about the unmet image promise only.
books_excluded_after_qa.beginner-watercolor-spanish: visual how-to niche with 0 interior images; its two siblings (acuarela ES, aquarelle FR) are the two books Amazon pulled. Not amplified until the content matches the promise.
books_excluded_after_qa.ai-augmented-productivity-toolkit: 25 orders are free-promo downloads, not paid demand; $1.96 lifetime in the most crowded niche in the catalogue.

channels.what: Bui posts the hub page link where the buyer already is (ADHD/productivity groups, accountant communities, bilingual-parent groups) — one post per book per week, no unsolicited DMs, no link drops in unrelated threads.
Pinterest pins to the hub page. Four pins were posted manually on 2026-07-10 (see data/manual-task-state.json); this reuses that channel with tracked links.

funnel: useful content on our own hub page -> one tracked CTA -> Amazon listing
hypothesis: Tracked organic links to hub pages for the three QA-passed earners produce measurable clicks; royalties for those books over the 30-day window stay at or above the baseline months below.
primary_metric: tracked reader clicks per book per campaign (hub_events, crawlers excluded)
secondary_metric: royalties_usd per book per month, latest observation per month
continue_if: at least 25 qualified clicks across the three books inside the 30-day window AND every tracked book still Live on the shelf. Meeting it justifies continuing the channel, not claiming sales.
stop_if: a tracked book's shelf row turns IN_REVIEW / BLOCKED / UNPUBLISHED (pause that book only), or the owner stops the experiment. Zero clicks at day 14 triggers diagnosis, not a stop.
attribution_rule: Amazon reports no referrer, so a purchase is never attributed to a click. Clicks prove reach; royalties are reported beside them. Insufficient evidence is reported as INCONCLUSIVE, never as success.

baseline.source: kdp_snapshots / kdp_title_attribution, latest observation per month
baseline.unknown_note: null means the book had no attributed row in that month's report: unknown, not zero. KDP only attributes titles that appear in the report it serves.

window_start_rule: first verified publication in `publications`, never a typed date and never the first click

publication_record_shape.slug: book slug the post points at
publication_record_shape.url: https:// live url of the published post or pin
publication_record_shape.observed_at: ISO-8601 when we saw it live
publication_record_shape.evidence: what was checked (e.g. 'opened the pin url, it resolves to the hub page')

threshold_meaning: 25 qualified clicks is a provisional acquisition signal (the channel reaches readers). It is not sales validation and must never be reported as one.
exposure_note: Impressions/saves exist only inside Pinterest analytics, which we do not read. Exposure stays null unless the owner reports figures; null is 'not measured', not zero.
day14_rule: Zero qualified clicks at day 14 triggers a distribution and tracking diagnosis (is the pin/post live? does the link resolve? are events recorded?). It never retires a book.
shelf_rule: Pause a book's campaign only when its shelf row is IN_REVIEW, BLOCKED, UNPUBLISHED or DRAFT. 'Live - Updates in review' is still selling: watch it, do not pause it.
metric_tracks: costs_usd (paid spend is 0 — no paid channel authorized)
no_inference_rule: Do not attribute a purchase to a click and do not derive a read-through rate from KENP. Clicks, orders, KENP and royalties are reported as separate observations.

qualification.method: listing.json + bookshelf roster (exact ASIN/format/price), ebook.md and ebook.epub file inspection (tables, write-in blanks, images, claim phrases), epubcheck result from catalogue_quality 2026-09-12, language-marker scan

adhd-adults-workbook-es.kindle_layout_risk: 195 table rows, up to 8 columns — wide tables reflow badly on a phone
adhd-adults-workbook-es.write_in_handling: templates tell the reader to copy the table into a notebook or print it; no blank lines to write on inside the ebook
adhd-adults-workbook-es.promote_note: link to the ebook ASIN; mention the paperback only as an alternative, never as the same product

bilingual-english-spanish-kids-vocab.kindle_layout_risk: 163 table rows, max 3 columns — reflows acceptably
bilingual-english-spanish-kids-vocab.write_in_handling: 'write your answers' lines address a notebook, not the ebook page; no blanks inside the ebook
bilingual-english-spanish-kids-vocab.promote_note: a vocabulary book for bilingual parents: say plainly that it is read on a screen

unverified: Semantic correctness of the Spanish, Portuguese and English text is UNTESTED — a marker scan found no wrong-language content, which is not the same as a native reading.
Kindle on-device rendering of the wide ADHD tables is UNTESTED (no Previewer run; a republish is frozen, so this is a caveat to the claim, not a fix).
KDP Select status comes from listing.json records of June/July. Re-read the KDP page before any direct-sale decision.

zero_sales_note: The 30 live books with no royalties are not called unmarketable: with no exposure data and no tracked traffic ever sent to them, nothing has been tested. Blocked and removed titles are not called irrecoverable either — no recovery route has been attempted or ruled out with evidence.
